spatial_reference: Upper/lower name the two fixed WR06 open-shelf levels. Either side beside the serving plate is a valid staging location; the expert's recorded left/right side is not part of the task label.

inspect_shelf.label: inspect the shelf levels to locate the ketchup bottle

pick_lower.label: pick up the ketchup bottle from the lower shelf

pick_upper.label: pick up the ketchup bottle from the upper shelf

place_plate.label: place the ketchup bottle beside the serving plate

pick_plate.label: pick up the ketchup bottle from beside the serving plate

return_lower.label: return the ketchup bottle upright to the lower shelf

return_upper.label: return the ketchup bottle upright to the upper shelf
